title: SKWorld module manifest (skworld.module.json)
description: The canonical cross-repo SKWorld subapp contract, schema v1.2. One capauth-signed manifest per first-class subapp, declaring the UI facet (rendered by the Dart shell via skworld_module_api) and the operator facet (observed/acted on by Atlas via operator_seat/adapter.py). v1.2 adds two OPTIONAL facets that turn a manifest into a pluggable capability pack: install (how the pack installs, as an ordered list of typed steps) and knowledge (the retriever Atlas auto-enables for RAG). v1.2 is a strict superset of v1.1: a v1.1 manifest (schemaVersion 1.1, no install/knowledge) still validates. Required properties reflect what the shipped manifests emit (skchat, skcode, skos, skdashboard). The reserved blocks (version, embed, theme, presence, notifications, core_modules) are from the umbrella-shell design 5.2 and are NOT emitted by any shipped manifest yet; they are defined here only so a future manifest that adds them still validates. additionalProperties is false: the contract is frozen.

schemaVersion.description: The sk-standards manifest schema version. 1.1 = v1 UI shape + the operator block. 1.2 = the same, plus the optional install and knowledge facets. A manifest that declares install or knowledge MUST be 1.2 (enforced below); a manifest with neither MAY stay 1.1.

id.description: Stable module id. Matches the SkworldModule.id in Dart, the skworld://<id>/ deep-link authority, and the shell/Atlas registry key.

name.description: Human-visible module name. Shipped manifests set this to the nav label (Chats, Code, OS, Board).

grade.description: UI composition grade. A = native in-process Flutter module (entry.flutter_package). B = web embed (entry.url). A grade promotion is a manifest edit plus a package, never a contract change.

entry.description: How the shell mounts the module. Grade A supplies flutter_package; Grade B supplies url.

url.description: Grade B: the web surface the shell embeds (built origin-relative by the serving daemon, e.g. http://<host>:9394/app).

flutter_package.description: Grade A: the Flutter package the shell mounts in-process. Workspace form is {path, package} (shipped); a promoted-to-own-repo form is {git, ref, package}.

nav.description: Primary-navigation placement metadata. Mirrors the Dart ModuleNav value type.

icon.description: Design-system icon token name (resolved against the sk-design-system icon set), never a URL.

order.description: Sort order among sibling modules; lower sorts earlier. Shipped: OS=10, Chats=20, Code=30, Board=40.

deeplinkPrefix.description: The skworld://<id>/ deep-link prefix this module answers to. NOTE: shipped manifests use camelCase deeplinkPrefix; the umbrella-shell design 5.2 text wrote deeplink_prefix (snake_case). The shipped camelCase spelling is canonical here.

auth.description: The audience-scoped token contract. The shell mints a short-lived token for this audience with a subset of these scopes; enforcement stays a downstream capauth.authz.decide call.

audience.description: The token audience minted for this module. Matches AuthContext.audience in Dart.

scopes.description: The full set of capability scopes the module may be granted (the shell mints a subset).

memory.description: Whether the module opts into skmemory, and its scope when it does.

scope.description: The memory scope, present only when opt_in is true.

health.description: The health endpoint (path or absolute URL). Shipped daemons build it origin-relative to the serving request (e.g. <base>/health, <base>/api/v1/hosts/self, <base>/api/status).

operator.description: The operator facet: what Atlas (operator_seat) observes and may act on. Its condition list MUST equal the app's Atlas adapter CONDITIONS (a drift-guard test asserts this per app). proposedStandardActions is a PROPOSAL ONLY; ratification is human-only in the fleet Operatorapp object's ratifiedStandardActions.

contractVersion.description: The operator-facet contract version. Frozen at 1.

cli.description: The CLI-first conformance entry point: <cli> explain|observe|act --json.

repos.description: The repos that implement this subapp (for Atlas escalation routing).

conditions.description: The condition names Atlas observes (each True/False/Unknown). Same vocabulary the shell's grey-with-a-reason availability can render.

proposedStandardActions.description: Standard actions the subapp PROPOSES Atlas may auto-apply. A proposal only: human ratification lives in the fleet Operatorapp object.

install.description: OPTIONAL (schema v1.2). The install facet: how this manifest, treated as a pluggable capability pack, activates its capability on a node. Consumed exactly once per node by the skos planner/provisioner (never by Atlas). Steps run in order, each with idempotent done/pending/failed check semantics; re-running is safe. Present only when the manifest packages a capability; a plain first-class subapp omits it.

requires.description: The gate the planner checks before running any step: node capabilities that must be present and package version floors that must be met.

capabilities.description: Node capability names that must be installed (skos capability catalog ids, e.g. skmem-pg).

packages.description: Map of package name to a version constraint the node must satisfy (e.g. {"skcapstone": ">=0.16"}).

steps.description: The ordered install steps. Each is one of the typed step kinds below. The provisioner executes them top to bottom and records per-step state in installed.json.

oneOf.description: sql_migration: apply an idempotent SQL script to a named database, optionally taking a pg_dump first and running a verify query after. The provisioner fails the step if verify does not pass.

script.description: Package-qualified path to the migration script ("<package>:<repo-relative-path>", e.g. skmemory:deploy/skmem-pg/03-ops-namespace.sql). Resolved from the package's installed data or repo checkout.

pre_dump.description: When true, take a pg_dump of the target DB before applying (live-node safety). Fresh first-boot init sets this false.

verify.description: Package-qualified path to a verify query the provisioner runs after apply; a mismatch fails the step.

oneOf.description: db_roles: create login roles and bind them to the migration's NOLOGIN group roles, with passwords sourced from skvault. Closes the "bind roles out-of-band" hole with a defined credential convention.

db.description: Target database capability the roles live in (e.g. skmem-pg).

logins.description: Map of login role name to the NOLOGIN group role it is GRANTed (e.g. {"skbrain_projector": "skbrain_ops_rw"}). Login roles are created if missing.

password_source.description: Where the provisioner reads (or creates on first install) each login's password. Only skvault is defined today.

vault_entries.description: Optional map of login role name to its skvault entry name (e.g. {"skbrain_projector": "SKBRAIN_PG_PROJECTOR_PW"}). When omitted, the provisioner derives a stable entry name by convention.

env_drop_in.description: Optional path to the environment.d drop-in the provisioner writes the DSNs/passwords into (e.g. ~/.config/environment.d/skbrain.conf).

oneOf.description: content_repo: clone a git repo to serve as the pack's canon content. Clones if absent, verifies a marker file, never touches an existing checkout.

dest.description: Clone destination path on the node (e.g. ~/clawd/skbrain-ops).

remotes.description: Optional list of git remote URLs to clone from (first reachable wins). When omitted, remotes are resolved from the named repo's own configuration.

private.description: Whether the repo is private (the provisioner uses the operator's git credentials rather than anonymous clone).

marker.description: A file whose presence in the checkout confirms the clone is the expected content repo (e.g. CLAUDE.md).

syncthing.description: When true, the provisioner PRINTS (never auto-applies) the Syncthing share instruction for this checkout.

oneOf.description: seed: run an idempotent seed command. Create-or-skip semantics are the command's own responsibility. defer_ok records the step as pending (not failed) when the command does not exist yet.

cmd.description: The seed command as an argv array (e.g. ["skoperator", "kedb-seed"]).

defer_ok.description: When true, a missing command records the step as pending instead of failing (how a pack ships before a dependency lands).

oneOf.description: fleet_objects: write per-node service/cron object specs into the fleet store as the human operator role (single-writer-per-file preserved). Existing objects are diffed, never blind-overwritten.

objects.description: Pack-relative paths to the fleet object spec templates to install (e.g. cronjob/skbrain-sync.json).

oneOf.description: doctor: register a doctor check family so skcapstone doctor and skos status cover the pack from the first run.

checks.description: The doctor check ids this pack registers (e.g. skbrain:schema, skbrain:grants).

knowledge.description: OPTIONAL (schema v1.2). The knowledge facet: WHERE this pack's retrievable knowledge lives, so the operator seat can auto-enable RAG enrichment when its capability probe passes. Consumed by the operator seat at bootstrap and by the dashboard's knowledge tab. It declares retrieval only, never policy: knowledge is not authority (the constitutional carve-out holds).

namespace.description: The skmem-pg schema/namespace the pack's content lives in (e.g. ops). The seat's probe checks information_schema.schemata for this before enabling the retriever.

search_fn.description: The schema-qualified hybrid-search function name the retriever calls (e.g. ops.hybrid_search_ops).

retriever.description: The <module>:<callable> that builds the retriever object (e.g. skos.skbrain.read_api:build_retriever). Imported by the seat when the probe passes.

reader_role.description: The read-only database role the seat connects as to probe and to retrieve (e.g. skbrain_ops_ro). Scopes retrieval to a role that cannot mutate the namespace.

graph.description: Optional AGE graph name exposing the pack's knowledge graph (e.g. ops_brain).

kinds.description: Optional content kinds the namespace holds (e.g. runbook, known-error, postmortem).

kedb.description: Optional flag: whether this pack's knowledge feeds the Known-Error Database linkage.

version.description: RESERVED (umbrella 5.2): the subapp's own version. Not emitted by any shipped manifest.

embed.description: RESERVED (umbrella 5.2): Grade B postmessage-v1 embed policy (handshake, allowed_origins, sandbox). Not emitted by any shipped manifest yet.

theme.description: RESERVED (umbrella 5.2): design-system token binding. Not emitted by any shipped manifest yet.

presence.description: RESERVED (umbrella 5.2): presence-plane consume/provide flags. Not emitted by any shipped manifest yet.

notifications.description: RESERVED (umbrella 5.2): badge/notify capability flags. Not emitted by any shipped manifest yet.

core_modules.description: RESERVED (umbrella 5.2): required Layer-0 core interface versions. Not emitted by any shipped manifest yet.

allOf.description: The install and knowledge facets are v1.2 features: a manifest that declares either MUST set schemaVersion to 1.2.
